name: law-crossdomain-v3.1
selection_philosophy: Lanes are selected EXCLUSIVELY by our own measured panel-information assay (calyx bits, #1474/#1913 machinery) on real corpus text — NOT external benchmarks/MTEB/pedigree. v3 measured every lane on the FIRST 1000 CHARACTERS of each opinion; v3.1 re-measures the identical sample, anchors and estimator with NO truncation, so lanes are ranked on whole opinions instead of on their openings. Admission follows the Calyx differentiation contract: keep a lane iff its measured marginal signal >= the 0.05-bit floor AND its max pairwise NMI <= the 0.6 redundancy ceiling. The second constraint is the measured search pin: the panel must fit the 8600 MiB pin budget, and where it does not, lanes are dropped by measured bits-per-MiB, never by role.

representation.pooled_paragraph: PoolPolicy::MeanTokenWeightedL2 over BoundaryPolicy::ParagraphCascade spans packed to the lane's OWN context window; emits one SlotShape::Dense vector per document and pins like any dense lane (#1980).
representation.segments_paragraph: Identical cascade boundaries and identical per-lane window, segments preserved as SlotShape::Multi. Awarded only where the measurement shows chunk-level retention is worth its pin.
representation.truncation: Structurally disabled. The runtime hardcodes truncate=false so an over-length input fails closed as CALYX_LENS_UNREACHABLE rather than becoming a silent prefix; the chunker's contract is that it never fires.
representation.chunk_multi_award_rule: Awarded to the lanes with the largest measured B-minus-C advantage, subject to the pin budget. Both awards are recorded in-file with their measured advantage and their measured pin.

assay.vault_sample: 1440 opinions, stratified balanced 480/label:cited class (none/some/high), spread across opinion_type x era-band x length-band; sources canonical-v4 (cap-cuyahoga + ohctapp8-modern) + ohio-sc-whole; deterministic top-k by sha256('assay1967-v3' | ingest_text_sha256) — the SAME 1440 opinions as the v3 assay, re-derivable from seed 'assay1967-v3'
assay.text_length: FULL LENGTH — no truncation. 14,977,687 characters total, 10,401 chars/doc mean, median 5,203, p95 38,134, max 284,029. The v3 assay measured 1000 chars/doc (1,440,000 characters), i.e. 9.6% of the text.
assay.estimator: ross_mixed_continuous_discrete_ksg_k3_cuda_strict_no_replacement (full native-dim L2 vectors), n=192 balanced subsample per anchor — unchanged from v3
assay.block_estimator: Multi/SegmentedMulti lanes are measured natively by their late-interaction MaxSim profile against 24 deterministic label-blind landmark blocks (#1892), never by pooling their segments into a surrogate — which is what makes the B-vs-C comparison a comparison of representations rather than of estimators
assay.co_residency: All 19 assayed lanes were co-resident in ONE panel for ONE ingest, so every pairwise NMI is measured between vectors of the same rows (the v3 assay needed four vaults; #1967 records why accumulating columns across panel swaps does not work).
assay.marginal_bits_definition: mean over 4 anchors of standalone MI(lens;anchor) discounted by (1 - max pairwise NMI to already-selected lanes) in greedy forward-selection order — identical arithmetic to v3, so the two columns are comparable

dropped.reason: DROP (measured pin, v3.1). Kept in v3 as a 'free' zero-VRAM lane — free of VRAM, but not free of pin. Measured on whole opinions its sparse inverted index projects to 3,195 MiB, 0.078 bits/GiB against 0.223 and 0.191 for the two chunk-Multi awards. Keeping it takes the panel to 10,389 MiB against an 8,600 MiB budget. Its lexical role is the least redundant thing lost (max NMI 0.384), so this is a real cost, recorded rather than hidden — the first candidate for the headroom if the budget is raised.

DROP (unmeasurable, v3.1). Its 8-dimension document-structure vector is degenerate under the Ross KSG estimator on full text — CALYX_ASSAY_DEGENERATE_INPUT, 'kth same-class radius is zero', because whole opinions collapse onto identical 8-dim coordinates. A lane whose contribution cannot be measured cannot be admitted by a measured-selection contract.

It is not free: the sparse head needs the in-process fastembed_bgem3 runtime (~1696 MiB) on a card that measured CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY across several TEI backends at full panel load. Admitting an unmeasured lane at real cost contradicts the selection contract.

truncation_finding.question: How much did ranking lanes on opinion openings distort the roster?
truncation_finding.answer: Materially. Over the 15 lanes measured under both, mean bits move by -0.193 to +0.086 and the ordering changes: bge-m3 falls from 7th to 14th, legal modernbert rises from 13th to 6th, specter2 from 15th to 5th. The direction is systematic — SHORT-context lanes lose (medembed -0.193, bam -0.177, e5 -0.165, paecter -0.138, bge-m3 -0.114) and LONG-context in-domain lanes gain (specter2 +0.086, legal +0.076, scincl +0.049) — because a 1000-character input is one window for every lane, so truncation measured all lanes at their best case and hid exactly the cost that pooling imposes on lanes needing many segments.
truncation_finding.consequence: The two lanes v3 would have called mid-table (medembed, e5) are the two whose segments are worth pinning, and the lane v3 ranked 3rd (BAM) is not. Neither call is derivable from the truncated numbers.

b_vs_c_measurement.design: Same lane, same endpoint, same cascade boundaries, same per-lane window; the ONLY difference is whether segments are pooled. Measured co-resident in one panel over one ingest, so both arms saw identical rows.
b_vs_c_measurement.candidates_rationale: medembed / specter2 / e5 only. The 8192- and 32k-context lanes pack to 1.00-1.04 segments per opinion, so pooling one segment is a no-op and B is identically C there — measuring them returns noise.

results.note: Third by advantage and below the sparse lane's bits-per-GiB; not awarded. Its pooled form already reads whole opinions well.

b_vs_c_measurement.reading: Pooling is lossy exactly where it is most needed. A 512-context lane pools ~4-8 segments of a full opinion and loses 0.21 bits doing it; a lane that pools one segment loses nothing. That is why the panel default is pooled (5.4 GB fits, 15.3 GB does not) and why the exceptions are bought where the loss is largest.

pin_measurement.method: Projected from physically measured index files of the 1,440-row full-text assay vault. Per-document lanes (flat_dense) scale by row count; content-scaling lanes (multi_maxsim_segments, sparse_inverted) are additionally corrected by the measured length bias of the stratified sample (10,401 vs 6,907 chars/doc = 1.506x).
pin_measurement.serving_behaviour_verified: Search on the assay vault reports a pin preflight of 339,097,524 bytes and fails closed with CALYX_SEARCH_PIN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED under a 64 MiB budget rather than degrading to a streamed path. The pin is therefore a real budget item for this panel, not something #1845 streaming makes free — which is why the chunk-Multi slots are rationed by measurement.
pin_measurement.unbounded_pin_search: 0.54-0.60 s wall, 461 MiB max RSS, 10 hits per query over 3 queries

budget_headroom_note: Selection totals 7,194 MiB of the 8,600 MiB pin budget (1,406 MiB headroom) and 5,654 MiB of the 10,240 MiB new-VRAM budget. The headroom is deliberately not spent: the sparse-law-keywords lane at 3,195 MiB is the named candidate for it if the pin budget is ever raised.
